fichas.title: Street Spaces
fichas.summary: Street spaces are formed by roads and surrounding buildings. Blacked-in plans make roads and squares read as cohesive areas against white building footprints. The spacing and height of opposing buildings affect whether a space feels closed or open; the page relates this perception to viewing angle and width-to-height proportions. Design aims include identity, orientation, and residential quality. Trees help define and structure street space, and planting layouts should account for mature tree size.
uses: Shape the perception of streets as open or closed spaces
